name.zh: 新加坡护照照片（ICA 电子服务上传）

notes.en: ICA Photo Guidelines: a new coloured photograph; recommended online upload size 400×514 pixels via e-Services; accepted extensions jpg, jpeg, heic, heif, png; maximum 8 MB (8192 KB). Do not alter or enhance facial features. Printed hardcopy photos must be matte or semi-matte; exact printed millimetres are not stated on this guidelines page (ICA forms used elsewhere state 35×45 mm — not copied here). Background hex and head ratio are not stated on the guidelines page. ICA states the requirements follow ISO/ICAO.
notes.zh: ICA 照片指引：须提交新的彩色照片；电子服务建议上传尺寸 400×514 像素；接受 jpg/jpeg/heic/heif/png；最大 8 MB（8192 KB）。不得改五官。纸质提交须亚光或半亚光；该指引页未写印刷毫米（其他 ICA 表格有 35×45 mm，本条未抄入）。底色色值与头部比例未写。ICA 称要求依据 ISO/ICAO。
